**Standard** = ส่งคำขอแล้วได้คำตอบทันที: **Standard** = send a request and get the answer right away (normal price) · **Batch** = submit work in bulk and collect results later (usually within 24 h) for roughly half the price, good for work that isn't urgent such as summarising many documents · not every model has a batch price
